name: Magecart card skimmer
description: Checkout skimmer that captures card number, CVV, expiry, cardholder and password fields, then exfiltrates them to a base64-hidden domain on keyup, change, submit and a timed heartbeat.

name: SupportBubble chat widget
description: Third-party chat widget that loads a script named in the URL query string, runs eval() on unvalidated postMessage data, ships PII via sendBeacon with a hardcoded key, and fires an insecure http pixel.

name: PulseMetrics tracker
description: Aggressive tracker: canvas, WebGL and audio fingerprinting plus full navigator enumeration, cookie-based ID, and cookie-sync beacons to multiple third-party exchanges with no consent gate.

name: ShopKit currency formatter
description: Clean currency-formatting widget. Fetches exchange rates from its own https API, writes prices with textContent, uses no cookies or sensitive data, and calls no third parties.

name: Obfuscated script loader
description: Heavily obfuscated loader (_0x string array with rotation, packer-style indirection, dense hex escapes) that reassembles a hidden delivery URL and injects a remote script, with a debugger anti-analysis loop.
